placement_note: 44 of 50 events name an admin-1 unit we hold a boundary for and can be drawn on the map. The rest are shown on the timeline with their recorded location as text, and are not placed anywhere.
magnitude_note: Markers show that an event was recorded and when, never how large it was. Reporting quality varies by country and improved over time, so sizing by casualties would rank countries by reporting.
